title: functionality continues to deteriorate
text:
this password manager stopped being able to differentiate between a username and an email address quite a long time ago and support just keeps telling me to clear cache as if i’m not using it on an iphone. so i “cleared cache” by deleting and reinstalling the app and of course that does not work because why would it? 

so that’s been an issue for well over a year now. and most recently, it has stopped allowing the creation of new logins without first going in to manually create it (as in, typing in the name of the site with your own fingers) before creating the account, at which time you will need to fight with the autofill feature that will erase your email address and put your username there instead, or vice versa.

title: Duo on iOS 27.2
text: I’d like to be able to designate username or password for individual website logins instead of having the app default to username, which means I have to leave the browser copy it from Proton Pass before returning to past it in the appropriate field. This disrupts my workflow frequently enough to be a problem. Lifetime subscriber who’s a fan and wants things to improve. It also would be nice to see robust Duo support.

title: Creates duplicate entries
text:
The browser extension duplicates entries.

Sometimes the sign in URL path varies slightly.  When signing in this leads to proton adding another entry as opposed updating the existing entry.  LastPass does substantially better check whether the domain portion is identical.  It’s a major annoyance since one accumulates a bunch of duplicate entries with different passwords.

title: Terrible Products and Worse Support
text:
I’ve tried for months to report an issue with Pass crashing the native Apple keyboard. One problem is the Feedback form in the app doesn’t work properly. The form itself expands past the screen after you attach a file so you can’t even see what you’re typing. Then you can’t even submit it because it says it’s not in JSON form. The other problem is even when I’ve gotten around that issue, they’ve only asked in turn ask me for a screenshot or recording…absolutely maddening. 

If you use other Proton products, you’re lucky if they work well enough to allow you to get anywhere. ProtonVPN connection stalls constantly…CONSTANTLY!!

Proton Mail doesn’t let you type if there’s no connection (see VPN stalling). 

Mail can’t even format text on iPhone. 

Calendar is a joke of a program that can’t even hold attachments.

It’s a miserable cycle being in this ecosystem. Their support sucks and their products are inferior to the point of making my smartphone worse than a landline. They just advertise bomb you to buy more of their accounts/products without being able to support their existing services.

title: Beta
text: Love the idea of what Proton is trying to do but all their products are still feeling like they’re in beta. Proton Pass, in particular, is a product that rarely works nearly as good as what comes on your device for free. Forget autofill, suggested passwords, recognizing websites you’ve saved passwords for, etc. It’s a “dumb” (and frustrating) password saver that takes too much time to use.

title: Not bad
text: A little behind Nord Pass on functionality - get used to manually updating because autofill won’t recognize and save new URLs for existing logins, unlike Nord Pass. Still an awesome project though!

title: Constant bugs and no support
text: The app is full of bugs on both mobile and desktop — attachments won’t open, and it keeps crashing on iPad. I reported the issues multiple times but no one fixed them, and the refund request was refused. Very disappointing experience.

title: Poor integration with faceid, totp
text: As a password manager it is functional. It does everything the desktop browser extension does. However, if you want to autocopy totp to clipboard, you need to enable biometric authentication. This check fails once every time because it fights with the ios built in faceid check. Using a username, password, and totp lookup for one site causes 3 failures and locks the vault. If you turn off system faceid, the app copies totp to clipboard but cannot paste the totp (nothing on clipboard) so this feature is not working as far as I can tell. The workaround is to manually tab back to the vault and manually cooy, switch back to safari, and long press to paste.

title: Disappointing
text: If you want to use a password manager just to be able to say that you use a password manager, this product will do nicely.
